Name: Cask Enabled Sheds
Author: DoctorHadley
Description:
[center][size=5][size=4]A simple mod to enable the use of casks within sheds and upgraded sheds.[/size]
[/size]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/Ko1ea81.png[/img]﻿[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b][/url]﻿ to replace the sheds.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kRxuUCD.png[/img]﻿
Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
Download the mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods
Run the game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[b][u]
[/u][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/79LBYyP.png[/img]﻿
[/b]Not compatible with mods that change the interior layout of sheds (Such as expanded shed mods.)[/b][/center]
